Google Antigravity `agy` CLI** | 按 Google 官方安装文"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"档 安装（支持 macOS / Linux / Windows）。`agy --version` 能输出版本号即表示安装成功 |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> 💡 **提示**：即使你的 agy 尚未登录，也可以直接安装插件！在 DSH 界面顶部点击 `AGY` 徽标或进入「设置 → Antigravity」，点击「➕ 添加账号」即可直接在浏览器中完成登"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"💡 **提示**：即使你的 agy 尚未登录，也可以直接安装插件！在 DSH 界面顶部点击 `AGY` 徽标或进入「设置 → Antigravity」，点击「➕ 添加账号」即可直接在浏览器中完成登录。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 🧩 架构与工作原理"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **短生命周期进程驱动**：每一轮 DSH 对话启动一个独立的官方 `agy -p --output-format stream-json` 进程，解析 NDJSON 事件流。
2. **多账号"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"沙箱机制**：除主账号沿用系统默认 Keychain / HOME 外，所有备用账号在插件私有目录下建立专属 HOME 隔离区，独立写入 agy 格式的标准 OAuth 凭证。Windows 上 ag"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"y 的凭据实际存放在机器级 Credential Manager（`gemini:antigravity`），插件因此以「身份级引用计数租约」接管该槽：**同一授权的多个会话并行运行**，只有账号**"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"身份切换**才串行，且由最后一个持有者还原主账号凭据。
3. **多 Bucket 官方配额汇总**：插件定时后台静默轮询官方 `v1internal:retrieveUserQuotaSummary"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"`，精准掌控每个账号的 5h 滚动削峰水位、7d 账号阶梯周额度，以及付费账号的 Argon 独立周池。
4. **会话级无缝故障转移**：当遭遇 HTTP 429、额度耗尽或凭证异常时，号池调度器自"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"动标记当前账号家族进入冷却（或按额度到期时间择优轮换），并无缝将后续请求路由到池内下一个有效账号。
5. **失败分类与自愈**：错误按 AUTH / NETWORK / RATE_LIMIT / E"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"LIGIBILITY 等精确分类；网络抖动借由 agy 运行日志自动甄别为可重试故障，绝不误伤健康账号的登录状态。
6. **辅助通道隔离**：`/tsl` 翻译、会话标题生成、任务目标推导等通过独立"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"专用辅助通道执行，共享号池与冷却机制，不占主会话绑定与工具权限。"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 🌟 Core Feature: Multi-Account Pool & Smart Rotation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Have multiple Google Antigravity / Gemini accounts? **dsh-agy-link makes multi-account orchestration"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" seamless and automated**:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- 👥 **Multi-Account Pooling**: Manage unlimited Google accounts (Primary + Secondary pool) with full"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"y isolated HOME sandbox environments and credentials.
- 🔄 **Sequential Drain Failover**: When an acc"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ount reaches its rate limits (429) or runs out of 5h/weekly quotas, requests **automatically and smo"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"othly fail over to the next available account** without interrupting your conversation!
- 🕰 **Quota-"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"Expiry-First Rotation**: With several accounts available, the scheduler prefers the one whose **rese"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t window expires soonest**, maximizing utilization across the whole pool.
- 🧠 **Jitter-Safe Auth Cla"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ssification**: A keyring-auth timeout caused by proxy jitter is recognized as a **retryable network "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"error**, not a sign-out — classified from the `keyringAuth` transport evidence in agy's own run log,"},{"id":"p17s9","text":" and sticky "needs re-login" quarantine requires a second confirmation, so healthy accounts are neve"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"r falsely flagged.
